name: whitewashed wall
description: A thick whitewashed brick wall.

name: unpainted cypress wall
description: A wall of pale, close-fitted cypress boards.

name: vermilion-lacquered wall
description: A wall of dark timber lacquered a deep vermilion.

name: narrow arched window
description: A tall, narrow window of leaded glass in pale blue and gold.

name: worn flagstone floor
description: Pale flagstones, worn smooth and hollowed by centuries of feet.

name: pale hinoki boards
description: Fine pale wooden boards, swept and faintly scented.

name: cobblestones
description: Rounded cobbles set in damp earth.

name: wrought-iron fence
description: A tall fence of black wrought-iron bars with gilded finials.

name: low wooden fence
description: A low fence of unpainted wooden rails.

name: heavy church doors
description: Tall double doors of dark oak with iron hinges.

name: open church doors
description: Tall double doors of dark oak with iron hinges.

name: lattice door
description: A sliding door of wooden lattice and paper.

name: open lattice door
description: A sliding door of wooden lattice and paper.

name: iconostasis
description: A tall carved and gilded screen of painted icons that divides the nave from the altar: saints and angels in gold and deep red.  Examine it to venerate the icons.

name: candle stand
description: A brass stand filled with sand, with thin beeswax candles burning in it.  Examine it to light a candle.

name: altar table
description: A square altar table covered in a white cloth, with a gospel book and a cross.

name: analoy
description: A tall wooden lectern with a slanted top, holding an icon of the saint of the day.  Examine it to kiss the icon.

name: church bell
description: A bronze bell hung in a timber frame, its rope worn smooth.  Examine it to ring it.

effect.u_message: You pull the rope.  A deep note rolls out over the roofs.

effect.u_make_sound: A church bell rings out across the district.

name: baptismal font
description: A wide stone font with a gilded cross above it, filled with clear water.

name: church bench
description: A plain wooden bench along the wall for the old and the tired.

name: stone cross
description: A tall stone cross on a stepped base, carved with a small roof and an eight-pointed arm.  Candle stubs sit at its foot.

name: torii gate
description: A vermilion gate of two round pillars and two crossbeams, marking the way to a shrine.

name: small shrine
description: A small raised wooden shrine with a lacquered door and a thick rope of rice straw above it, set on a stone plinth.  Examine it to bow before it.

name: guardian lion-dog statue
description: A weathered stone lion-dog on a plinth, sitting upright with its mouth open or shut to guard the shrine.

name: ema rack
description: A wooden frame hung with small wooden prayer plaques, each painted and written on with a wish.  Examine it to read some.

name: offering box
description: A slatted wooden offering box with a rope hanging in front.  Examine it to make an offering of a hundred yen.

name: purification basin
description: A stone water basin under a small roof, with a few bamboo ladles laid across it.  Examine it to wash your hands.

name: sacred rope
description: Two posts with a thick rope of rice straw and white paper streamers hung between them.

name: offering table
description: A low wooden table with dishes of rice, salt and sake set out for the spirits.

name: charm counter
description: A lacquered counter with rows of small brocade charms, paper talismans and wooden plaques for sale.

name: hanging lamp
description: A round paper lamp hung from a bracket, glowing a warm amber.
A small brocade pouch on a cord, stitched shut, with a prayer inside.  Sold at shrines for luck and safety.  Carrying it is a comfort.

use_action.menu_text: Hold it and make a wish

description: A strip of paper stamped with the name of a shrine's spirit in black and red ink, kept on a household shelf.
A small wooden plaque with a painted picture and a handwritten wish on the back.
A narrow strip of paper from a shrine, with a fortune on it.  Use it to read.

effect.u_message: You unfold the slip and read.  Great blessing: patience will bring what haste cannot.

description: A short wooden wand with two zigzag paper streamers, waved by a shrine priest to purify.  It is a flimsy club.
A white ceremonial robe and pale hakama trousers, as worn by a shrine priest.
A small hand-painted icon on a wooden panel: a saint's face in gold leaf, dark paint and a deep red border.  Examine one in your hand to venerate it.

use_action.description: A quiet moment before the icon.

description: A loop of black wool knots with a small cross, used to count prayers.
A brass censer on three short chains with little bells, used to carry fragrant smoke before the icons.
A thin, tall beeswax candle, bought at the church door.
A heavy gospel book with a silver-gilt cover and ribbon markers, set in Church Slavonic and Russian.
A small round loaf of leavened bread stamped with a cross, baked for the liturgy and given out afterwards.  Soft, plain and filling.
Clean water blessed by a priest and given out in plain bottles.  It tastes of nothing, but you feel a little steadier after drinking it.

dynamic_line: Peace to you.  Come in, come in: the doors are open to everyone, whoever you are and whoever you work for.  Fighting is left at the door here.

responses.text: Is it really safe here, with the syndicate about?

dynamic_line: Of course.  Take one from the box and set it in the sand, and say whatever you need to say.  God hears the short prayers as well as the long.
Our parish is old, and poor, and stubborn.  The icons came from the old country with the first families.  The bell still rings, the candles still burn, and on a feast day the whole street comes.

Inside these walls, yes.  The men from the syndicate bring their mothers here, and they keep the peace, as long as no one breaks it.  If someone does break it, I would not like to be standing in the way.
Welcome.  Please wash your hands at the basin, bow at the gate, and walk at the edge of the path, for the middle belongs to the spirits.
Bow twice, clap twice, and bow once more.  Say what you wish for, and leave a coin in the box.  It is the manner, not the amount, that matters.
A shrine has stood on this ground longer than the towers.  People come to ask for a safe road, a healthy child, a good exam.  Few of them stay, but most of them return.
There are charms and fortune slips at the counter, left out for anyone who needs them.  Please take what you need, and leave a coin if you can.

effect.u_message: You stand before the icons, cross yourself and bow.  The gold glows in the candlelight, and for a moment the noise of the city is far away.
You light a thin beeswax candle, set it among the others and say a short, quiet prayer.
You kiss the icon on the lectern.  The painted face looks back at you, calm and patient.
You stop, bow twice, clap twice and bow once more before the little shrine.  A breeze moves the paper streamers.
You read the plaques, each a small, private wish: a good harvest, an exam, a safe return, a long life.
You drop a coin in the box, ring the bell, bow twice, clap twice and bow once more.  You feel lighter somehow.

false_effect.u_message: You do not have the coins to spare.

effect.u_message: You rinse your left hand, then your right, then your mouth.  The cold water clears your head.
You close your hand around the charm and make a wish.  It helps, a little.
You hold the icon and look into the painted face.  A quiet, steady calm settles over you.
